title: Previewing GPT-5.6 Sol: a next-generation model
summary: OpenAI previews GPT-5.6 Sol, a next-generation model with stronger capabilities in coding, science, and cybersecurity, paired with its most advanced safety stack.
body: OpenAI previews GPT-5.6 Sol, a next-generation model with stronger capabilities in coding, science, and cybersecurity, paired with its most advanced safety stack.
summaryZh: OpenAI近日官方预览了新一代大模型GPT-5.6 Sol。该模型在编程能力、科学研究以及网络安全等关键任务上表现出更强的综合实力，并配备了OpenAI迄今为止最先进的安全堆栈，标志着其在多领域智能应用方面持续迭代升级。
